# The Bet · FinWise

> Module 1 · Ignite a PLG Motion. The growth hypothesis and where you're betting, plus the growth-loop visualization.

## Growth hypothesis

FinWise's biggest growth problem is FinWise has a persistent activation problem, with approximately 98% of trial users failing to convert to paid., because We have not yet established which product behaviors cause users to reach meaningful value during the trial..

_Working notes: I think FinWise's biggest problem is that the product is failing to deliver enough early and sustained value to users, causing both very low trial-to-paid conversion and high paid-customer churn. Evidence: I would use these three observations:

Only 2% of trials convert.
That's an extremely large funnel leak. Before spending more money acquiring users, I'd want to understand why users aren't reaching value.
Only 40% of paid customers are retained after one year.
Even after conversion, 60% churn. That suggests this isn't merely an acquisition problem—it may be a value realization / product engagement problem.
More paid acquisition isn't producing meaningful growth.
This is an important signal that FinWise is already pushing harder on the top of the funnel without sufficiently improving the middle and bottom of the funnel. Against the data: The data confirms that trial-to-paid conversion is the largest measurable funnel problem, but it does not prove that onboarding is the root cause. The ~2% conversion rate remains remarkably consistent across 13 months, even as traffic, trials, session duration, and other engagement metrics vary significantly. I would therefore identify the product behaviors that most strongly correlate with conversion before choosing a specific activation intervention._

_____

## The bet

Identify the core behaviors associated with conversion and test a collaboration-based activation experience that encourages users to involve another financial stakeholder in completing those behaviors.

**Not doing:** I am deliberately not increasing paid acquisition or launching a broad referral program first. The data suggests that adding more traffic is unlikely to solve the fundamental conversion problem, and there is not yet sufficient evidence that referrals are the strongest growth mechanism.

_____

## Growth loop

**Loop type:** Collaboration, FinWise's financial-management use case naturally involves multiple stakeholders such as business owners, accountants, bookkeepers, and finance teams. A collaboration loop could deepen product adoption while simultaneously creating additional product users, potentially addressing both the low trial-to-paid conversion and weak long-term retention.
